name: usage-band
description: Band above the prompt with an animated mascot that suggests the next step: context ring, prompt-cache thermometer with cold alerts and optional keep-warm, plan limits with pace bars and weekly day tiles, or API spend gauge vs budget, plus token split and warnings.

budgetUsd.title: API budget (USD)
budgetUsd.description: API-credit sessions only: session spend budget for the bar, ETA and warning. 0 turns it off.

turnWarnUsd.title: Expensive turn warning (USD)
turnWarnUsd.description: API-credit sessions only: toast when a single turn costs at least this much. 0 turns it off.

keepWarm.title: Keep prompt cache warm
keepWarm.description: Ping the cache shortly before it lapses while you are idle, so the next message reads it instead of re-caching the whole context. Each ping is a cheap cache read, billed to the session. Also toggled with /keep-warm.

keepWarmMaxPings.title: Keep-warm pings per idle stretch
keepWarmMaxPings.description: Most pings sent between two of your messages; resets when you send one. 0 means never ping (alerts only).

coldMinTokens.title: Cache alert minimum (tokens)
coldMinTokens.description: No cold alerts or keep-warm pings while the context is smaller than this; a small context is cheap to re-cache.
